title: A small survey to better understand film posters for research

commenti.body: Just as a heads up, the images on fellowship of the ring still have the letterboxd UI visible. Also I feel like some of these picks don’t take into account reference to previous entries, like Scream 2 - not exactly a traditional “floating heads” poster since it’s a take on the first poster and helps make it clear that it’s a continuation of the series.
